lines.zh: 我提着刀，从铺子后面走出来
lines.en: I come out from behind the shop with my cleaver

lines.zh: 围裙上还有昨天的印子
lines.en: The apron still carries yesterday's marks
My steps are solid on the flagstones
The cleaver sits in my hand, out of habit

lines.zh: 我走到案板边上，先看一眼
lines.en: I go to the block and look it over first

lines.zh: 这村子不大，铺子就我一个
lines.en: The village is small, I am the only shop

lines.zh: 我肩上搭着布，手上是油
lines.en: A cloth on my shoulder, grease on my hands
I walk slowly so as not to brush anyone
The meat has to be hung out in the morning
I pass the flowers without a glance

lines.zh: 有人喊我，我回头应一声
lines.en: Someone calls and I turn to answer

lines.zh: 铺子门口的铃，我挂了很多年
lines.en: I have hung that bell over the door for years
I stand behind the block and hone the blade

lines.zh: 磨刀石的声音一下一下
lines.en: The whetstone scrapes over and over
The meat hangs from a hook, still dripping

lines.zh: 我擦了擦手，又擦不干净
lines.en: I wipe my hands and they do not come clean
Few come by, so I wait

lines.zh: 我把刀背在围裙上蹭两下
lines.en: I rub the flat of the blade on my apron

lines.zh: 门口的风把香味吹出去
lines.en: The wind at the door carries the smell out
This trade came down in my family
There is a deep scar in the block

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天，快中午了
lines.en: I glance up, it is nearly noon

lines.zh: 我不吆喝，香味会替我说话
lines.en: I do not call out, the smell speaks for me

lines.zh: 有人来过又走了，什么都没买
lines.en: Someone came and left without buying
I fold the cloth again
In this trade, the hand must be steady

lines.zh: 你站在这儿，是要买什么
lines.en: Standing there, what will you have
I look up at you without stopping my hands
The cleaver is down, do not fret

lines.zh: 你这身衣服，不像本地人
lines.en: Your clothes are not from here

lines.zh: 我这铺子只卖两样东西
lines.en: I sell only two kinds of things here
Look if you like, but do not touch

lines.zh: 围裙上的印子，别盯着看
lines.en: Do not stare at the marks on my apron

lines.zh: 你的手很干净，不干活吧
lines.en: Your hands are clean, you do not work
I have seen you at the village gate
For directions, ask the smith
In my trade, we do not talk much
You are blocking the light on my block
Buy or do not, but do not stand too long

lines.zh: 你身上的味儿，我闻得出干过什么
lines.en: I can smell what you have been doing
That blade of yours is ground too thin

lines.zh: 案板上的东西，你碰不得
lines.en: What is on the block is not for touching

lines.zh: 你看着我这把刀，眼睛不眨
lines.en: You stare at this blade without blinking

lines.zh: 要买就说，不说就站边上去
lines.en: Say it if you are buying, otherwise step aside
That one cut me
I retreat behind the block
Wet hands are the slippery ones

lines.zh: 我在这一行做了半辈子，没这么挨过
lines.en: Half a lifetime in this trade, never hit like that
The blade is still in my hand
I press the cloth to the wound
It hurts, but I cannot go down
One more mark on the apron
I grit my teeth and make no sound
I do not take that

lines.zh: 我卖肉，不收生面孔的东西
lines.en: I sell meat, I do not take things from strangers

lines.zh: 拿来我看看，别放在案板上
lines.en: Hand it here, do not put it on the block
This is worth very little
What do you want in exchange, say it plainly
My shop takes only two things
Do not shake, I do not bite
This smells off, not like food
Leave it on the table, I will look later

lines.zh: 柜台上的东西，我都要称一称。
lines.en: Everything on the counter gets weighed.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我手上的刀晃了一下
lines.en: You bumped me and the cleaver shifted
The floor is slick, steady yourself

lines.zh: 别从后面来，我手上有刃
lines.en: Do not come from behind, I am holding an edge
I raised the blade, do not crowd me
You stepped on my apron

lines.zh: 我退了半步，靠在案板上
lines.en: I step back against the block
That set the hanging meat swinging

lines.zh: 我这身子不算壮，可也不怕撞
lines.en: I am not a big man, but I do not fear a shove
Give me room, I need to pass
Crowd me again and the blade hits the floor
At my age, that is long past
There is only one bed behind the shop

lines.zh: 我一天到晚跟肉打交道
lines.en: I spend the day with meat

lines.zh: 你身上没有油味，我们不合适
lines.en: You carry no grease, we do not suit
People keep away from my trade
The shop cannot be left unwatched
I have no fine words
If you want meat, I will cut it for you

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，还是守着案板吧
lines.en: At my age I will stay with the block
That is the end of it

lines.zh: 我手上是油，捡东西会滑
lines.en: My hands are greasy, things slip from them

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，沾了土就不卖
lines.en: What falls to the floor is soiled, not for sale
I bend and my apron touches the floor
This has to go to one side
I pick it up, look, and set it down

lines.zh: 掉在案板边的，我扫到桶里
lines.en: What drops by the block goes in the pail
The cleaver has to go down first
I do not take things for nothing
If you want it, come get it

lines.zh: 有人在我铺子前面站住了
lines.en: Someone has stopped in front of my shop
I have not put the cleaver down
This stretch is my doorstep

lines.zh: 你站的位置，挡着客人了
lines.en: Where you stand blocks my customers

lines.zh: 我看你的手，比看你的脸多
lines.en: I look at your hands more than your face

lines.zh: 我这人不惹事，也不怕事
lines.en: I do not start trouble, nor do I fear it
The block is right at my hand
If you mean to start something, think first

lines.zh: 我把围裙的带子系紧了
lines.en: I tighten the apron strings

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，越来越近
lines.en: Your smell is getting closer

lines.zh: 这条街上的人都认得我
lines.en: Everyone on this street knows me

lines.zh: 我没喊人，是给你留面子
lines.en: I have not called for help, that is courtesy

lines.zh: 门口的石阶，我踩了二十年
lines.en: I have trodden that step for twenty years
You had better state your business
I shift the blade to my right hand
It is not too late yet

lines.zh: 我跟着你，从铺子这头到那头
lines.en: I follow you from one end of the shop to the other
Run and you will find people everywhere

lines.zh: 这条巷子只有一个出口
lines.en: This alley has only one way out

lines.zh: 我手里的东西，你知道是什么
lines.en: You know what is in my hand

lines.zh: 我脚步不快，可我很熟路
lines.en: I am not quick, but I know these streets

lines.zh: 你在肉钩子旁边站太久了
lines.en: You have stood by the hooks too long
I heard you switch hands

lines.zh: 这铺子里没有能躲的地方
lines.en: There is nowhere to hide in this shop
I have let the door curtain down
The block is at your back now
The lamp shows you clearly
Put down what is in your hand
There is an old blade by the block
I would rather not soil the apron
Years in this trade make the hand steady
You have nowhere left to go
The flat of the blade slaps your wrist
I shove you once, without much force
That was the handle

lines.zh: 你撞在案板上，肉钩在响
lines.en: You hit the block and the hooks ring
Your hand opened and the thing fell

lines.zh: 我挡了一下，手上多了道口子
lines.en: I blocked, and there is a cut on my hand
You are at the door now, good
I will not follow up on that

lines.zh: 你做买卖不行，打架也不行
lines.en: You are no good at trade and no good at this
I plant the cleaver back into the block
There is sweat on your face
I pin you against the door frame

lines.zh: 这一手是切肉练出来的
lines.en: That grip came from cutting meat
Either walk out or lie down
I have not started in earnest
The shop curtain lifts
I hang today's meat on the hooks
A new shadow on the flagstones
Apron tied, blade honed
I light the shop lamp first

lines.zh: 这村子多了一家开门的铺子
lines.en: One more shop is open in this village
I wipe down the block
Few people in the morning, good for opening
The bell at the door rings once

lines.zh: 我从后屋出来，手上还湿
lines.en: I come from the back room, hands still wet
Today's stock is good

lines.zh: 街上的人看见我，都点头
lines.en: People on the street nod when they see me
A new smell has drifted in
I lean on the door frame a moment
Another day begins

lines.zh: 我看了看天，把肉盖上布
lines.en: I check the sky and cover the meat with cloth

lines.zh: 铺子里还有昨天的账没算
lines.en: Yesterday's accounts are still unsettled

lines.zh: 铺子里的油一见火就旺
lines.en: The grease in the shop feeds the fire

lines.zh: 我摔在石板路上，膝盖磕了一下
lines.en: I fell on the flagstones and cracked my knee

lines.zh: 水里浮不起来，我手上还拿着东西
lines.en: I cannot float, and my hands are full
The blast sets my ears singing
An arrow stands in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股劲儿让我手上的刀都握不住
lines.en: That force left me unable to grip the blade

lines.zh: 铺子里有肉，我却不能吃自己的货
lines.en: There is meat in the shop and I cannot eat my own stock
At the thunder I dropped the blade

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我踩不着石板
lines.en: No ground here, no flagstones underfoot
